nbFreeFull: Incwadi yakho yamanothi yamahhala isigcwele (amagama angu-{max}). Nge-Individual, wonke amagama owabhekayo ayagcinwa.
prRowCore: Zonke izincazelo, izibonelo, izisho namatemu, nomsuka wegama
prRowRead: Wonke amagama: thatha isithombe sekhasi, uthinte noma yiliphi igama
prRowChildren: Kufika ezinganeni ezi-5, ngayinye inesikhala sayo
wallAnonBody: Ukubhalisa kwamahhala okusheshayo kukuvulela ukubheka amagama ayi-10 ngosuku, nazo zonke izincazelo, izibonelo, Izisho namatemu, no-Umsuka Wegama.
wallBasicBody: I-akhawunti yamahhala ifaka ukubheka amagama ayi-10 ngosuku. Lo mkhawulo ubuya kusasa, noma uzame i-Individual ukuze uthole ukubheka okungenamkhawulo, izithombe nawo wonke amathuluzi okufunda.
sayPaidBody: Yisho iyingxenye yamaphakheji e-Individual, Family ne-Schools.
famSingleChild: Kunomfundi oyedwa nje ekhaya? I-Individual ingu-{price} ngenyanga. Uma wengeza kancane, i-Family ifaka izingane ezifika kwezi-5.
featFamPeople: Yonke ingane ithola wonke amathuluzi, ngemodi yezingane. Umzali ukhokha kanye kuphela ngomndeni wonke.
demoPlusMore: Futhi nokunye: ama-quiz, imidlalo nemiqhudelwano yamagama
partnersCalcNote: Isilinganiso sisuselwa kuhlelo lwe-Individual kanye nezinga lika-25%. Amakhasimende e-Yearly, Family ne-Schools akhuphula lokhu.
helpSwitchA1: Vula ikhasi le-akhawunti yakho bese uthepha okuthi "Shintshela ku-Family". Ukubhalisa kwakho kwamanje kubuyekezwa ekhadini elifanayo, ngaphandle kokulifaka futhi.
helpSwitchA2: I-Stripe ibala umehluko wezinsuku ezisele esikhathini samanje, ngakho ukhokha umehluko kuphela.
helpChargeA1: Izinkokhiso zivela njenge-GADIT noma i-GADIT.APP. I-Individual ingu-$3.99 ngenyanga noma u-$39.99 ngonyaka, kanti i-Family ingu-$5.99 ngenyanga noma u-$59 ngonyaka. Kwa-Israel inkokhiso iba ngamashekeli: ₪14.90 noma ₪149 ye-Individual, ₪19.90 noma ₪199 ye-Family. Okubhaliswe ngaphambi kuka-Okthoba 2026 kugcina intengo eyaqala ngayo. Uma inani lingafani, kungenzeka livela kwenye isevisi.
helpCompareQ: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwe-Basic, Individual ne-Family?
helpCompareA1: I-Basic (mahhala): kufika ekubhekeni amagama angu-10 ngosuku, zonke izincazelo, izibonelo, Izisho namatemu, Umsuka Wegama, ne-Incwadi yamanothi enamagama afinyelela ku-30.
helpCompareA2: Individual ($3.99 a month or $39.99 a year, ₪14.90 or ₪149 in Israel): umuntu oyedwa, wonke amathuluzi. Ukubheka amagama okungenamkhawulo, isithombe sencazelo ngayinye, incazelo efanele esuselwa emshweni, Every Word, Say it, ukwakha umusho onezimpendulo, imisho eyizibonelo eyengeziwe nemibuzo ngegama ngalinye, izwi lokufunda elizwakala ngokwemvelo, ukusebenzisa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, imidlalo, ama-quiz nemiqhudelwano yamagama, nokuzilolonga okuhlakaniphile okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela isivivinyo nedikiteshini.
helpCompareA3: I-Family ($5.99 ngenyanga noma u-$59 ngonyaka, ₪19.90 noma ₪199 kwa-Israel): konke okuku-Individual kwezingane ezifika ku-5 nabazali bobabili, kanye nemodi yezingane, indawo yayo siqu yengane ngayinye, ibhodi yomzali enezaziso zamagama, no-Ukupela.
remSubject: Sawubona {name}, isivivinyo sakho se-Gadit siphela ezinsukwini ezimbili
remBody:
Sawubona {name},

Isivivinyo sakho samahhala se-Gadit siphela ngo-{date}.

## Kuzokwenzekani ngemva kwalokho
Ngalolo suku ikhadi lakho lizokhokhiswa u-{amount} {cycle} nge-{plan}.

Akukho okudingeka ukwenze ukuze uqhubeke.

## Indlela yokukhansela
Ungakhansela noma nini ngaphambi kuka-{date}, futhi akukho ozokhokhiswa.

1. Vula [ikhasi lakho le-akhawunti](/account).
2. Thepha okuthi "Phatha ukukhokha".
3. Ekhasini elivulekayo, khetha ukukhansela ukubhalisa.
pupBody:
Sawubona {name},

Siyabonga ngokusebenzisa i-Gadit ku-Android.

I-akhawunti yakho okwamanje iku-Basic plan.

Ungathola wonke amathuluzi nge-Individual ne-Family plan.

## Family

Eyabazali nezingane.

Kufika ezinganeni ezingu-5, ngayinye ine-Incwadi yamanothi yayo, imodi Izingane ne-dashboard yomzali.

## Individual

Eyomuntu oyedwa.

Ukubheka amagama okungenamkhawulo nawo wonke amathuluzi.

Zombili ziqala ngezinsuku eziyi-14 zamahhala.

Ungakhansela noma nini ngaphambi kokuphela kwesivivinyo, futhi ngeke ukhokhiswe lutho.

Uma usubhalisile, uhlelo lokusebenza luzivuselela lona lodwa.

Vele ungene ngemvume nge-akhawunti efanayo.

prRowHomework: Usizo ngomsebenzi wasekhaya lwezingane: ukufunda, izivivinyo nedikiteshini
